readings: Looking only at processing runs whose RAM usage (`memusagegb`) is at least 60.8 GB and whose site code (`zoneref`) matches a site, first work out, for each site code and site access status (`entrystat`), the average RAM usage and the average GPU-to-CPU usage ratio (`procgpu` ÷ `proccpu`), ignoring missing values. Then, for each access status, give the access status, the average of those per-site average RAM usages, and the average of those per-site average GPU/CPU ratios, unrounded.
queries:
WITH site_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram_usage,
    AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing AS p
  JOIN sites AS s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
SELECT
  entrystat,
  AVG(avg_ram_usage),
  AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio)
FROM site_averages
GROUP BY entrystat
